title: Ground station audio
description: One object per message on gsu/{station_id}/audio. Published ONLY while the squelch is open - a station that streams continuously is the single most expensive thing on a metered link. See contract/transport.md.

rate.description: Sample rate in Hz. 24000 today; the console resamples to whatever the browser grants. Bounded because a consumer resampling by ctx.sampleRate/rate turns a small number into a very large allocation and a zero into a division by zero - the range is wide enough for any real airband receiver and narrow enough that the arithmetic downstream stays finite.

pcm.description: Mono signed 16-bit little-endian PCM. Wasteful and known to be so - expect this to become binary frames with Opus, so keep the encoding behind one function. Bounded well above the ~8 kB a frame actually carries: audio is a stream of short chunks, not a file.
